pages.text: Serene Seasons turns the Overworld year into four seasons: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter. Each splits into Early, Mid and Late.$(br2)By default every sub-season lasts 8 days, so a season is 24 days and a year 96. Foliage colors follow the season.

pages.title: Calendar
pages.text: Its tooltip shows the current season and day. Crafted from a Clock and paper. Handy for planning plantings.
Winter brings snow and ice generation. Rain, snow and storm frequency vary with the season. Tropical biomes (deserts, badlands, savanna, jungle and similar) have Wet and Dry seasons instead.
pages.title: Weather

pages.text: The big rule: crops only grow in the right season. Out of season they grow slowly or not at all, depending on the config. Tooltips may list a crop's seasons.$(br2)Winter is hardest: very few crops grow. $(l:survival/seasons_crops)Details$(/l).
pages.title: Crops

pages.text: Two ways around it. Plants under a glass roof count as in season, using the greenhouse glass tag (ordinary glass blocks). Crops deep underground are also fertile, below a height set in the config.
pages.title: Greenhouses
Season Sensor
pages.text: Emits a redstone signal depending on the season, like a Daylight Detector. Lets machines react to the time of year.
Seasonal Integration is a datapack that teaches Serene Seasons about other mods: it adds crops to the season lists and sorts biomes into tropical or off-limits.
pages.title: Seasonal Integration
